sentences.en: Before we build manifolds, let us gather three tools from the last episode.
sentences.zh: 在构造流形之前，先从上一集取出三件工具。

sentences.en: Last time we described nearness using only open sets, with no distances and no coordinates.
sentences.zh: 上一集我们只用开集来描述“靠近”，不需要距离，也不需要坐标。

sentences.en: A topology is a collection of open sets that contains the empty set and the whole space.
sentences.zh: 拓扑是一组开集，它包含空集 ∅ 和全空间，

sentences.en: It is closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.
sentences.zh: 并且对任意并和有限交封闭。

sentences.en: A map f is continuous when the preimage of every open set is open.
sentences.zh: 映射 f 连续，是指每个开集的原像都是开集。

sentences.en: And a homeomorphism is a bijection that is continuous, with a continuous inverse.
sentences.zh: 同胚是连续的双射，并且它的逆映射也连续。

sentences.en: Both directions matter. Wrap the interval from zero to two pi around the circle, sending t to cosine t, sine t.
sentences.zh: 两个方向都重要。把区间 [0, 2π) 卷到圆上：t ↦ (cos t, sin t)。

sentences.en: This map is a continuous bijection.
sentences.zh: 这个映射是连续双射。

sentences.en: But take a small open arc around the point one, zero.
sentences.zh: 但在点 (1, 0) 附近取一小段开弧。

sentences.en: Points just above one, zero come from parameters near zero, and points just below come from parameters near two pi.
sentences.zh: (1, 0) 上方的点来自 0 附近的参数，下方的点来自 2π 附近的参数。

sentences.en: So the inverse tears this arc into two distant pieces. It is not continuous at one, zero, and the map is not a homeomorphism.
sentences.zh: 所以逆映射把这段弧撕成相距很远的两段：它在 (1, 0) 处不连续，这不是同胚。

sentences.en: A homeomorphism matches open sets with open sets, so it preserves nearness. It says nothing about smoothness.
sentences.zh: 同胚把开集一一对应到开集，因而保持靠近关系；它不涉及光滑性。

sentences.en: In this episode, a chart will be exactly a homeomorphism onto an open subset of R d.
sentences.zh: 本集中，chart 恰好就是到 ℝᵈ 某个开子集的同胚。

sentences.en: A small piece of the Earth fits on a flat map with nothing torn, but no single flat map covers the whole globe.
sentences.zh: 地球上的一小块区域可以毫无撕裂地画在平面地图上，但没有一张平面地图能盖住整个地球。

sentences.en: The circle S one is the one-dimensional version of this story.
sentences.zh: 圆 S¹ 是这件事的一维版本。

sentences.en: S one is the set of points x, y in the plane with x squared plus y squared equal to one.
sentences.zh: S¹ 是平面上满足 x² + y² = 1 的点 (x, y) 的集合。

sentences.en: Here is the definition. Let M be a topological space.
sentences.zh: 定义如下。设 M 是一个拓扑空间。

sentences.en: A chart of dimension d is a pair U, phi, where U is an open subset of M,
sentences.zh: d 维 chart 是一对 (U, φ)，其中 U 是 M 的开子集，

sentences.en: and phi is a homeomorphism from U onto an open subset of R d.
sentences.zh: φ 是从 U 到 ℝᵈ 某个开子集的同胚。

sentences.en: The numbers phi of p are called the local coordinates of the point p.
sentences.zh: φ(p) 称为点 p 的局部坐标。

sentences.en: Let us build one. Take the upper half of the circle, where y is positive, and call it U plus.
sentences.zh: 来构造一个。取圆的上半部分（y > 0），记作 U₊。

sentences.en: The chart phi plus simply records the x coordinate of each point.
sentences.zh: chart φ₊ 只记录每个点的 x 坐标。

sentences.en: Dropping each point straight down, the open upper arc lands on the open interval from minus one to one.
sentences.zh: 把每个点竖直落下，开的上半弧落在开区间 (−1, 1) 上。

sentences.en: The inverse lifts x back to the circle: phi plus inverse of x is the point x, square root of one minus x squared.
sentences.zh: 逆映射把 x 抬回圆上：φ₊⁻¹(x) = (x, √(1 − x²))。

sentences.en: As x slides across the interval, the lifted point slides along the arc.
sentences.zh: x 在区间中滑动，抬起的点就沿圆弧滑动。

sentences.en: Now let us check, one item at a time, that this really is a chart.
sentences.zh: 现在逐条检查它确实是一个 chart。

sentences.en: First, U plus is open in S one, because it is the circle intersected with the open upper half plane.
sentences.zh: 第一，U₊ 在 S¹ 中是开集：它是圆与开上半平面的交。

sentences.en: In the subspace topology, such an intersection is an open set of the circle.
sentences.zh: 在子空间拓扑中，这样的交就是圆上的开集。

sentences.en: Second, phi plus is continuous, since it is the coordinate projection restricted to U plus.
sentences.zh: 第二，φ₊ 连续：它是坐标投影在 U₊ 上的限制。

sentences.en: Third, it is injective. Suppose two points of U plus have the same x.
sentences.zh: 第三，单射。设 U₊ 中两点的 x 相同。

sentences.en: Both heights are the positive square root of one minus x squared, so the points coincide.
sentences.zh: 两者的高度都是正根 √(1 − x²)，所以两点重合。

sentences.en: It is also onto the interval. Take any x strictly between minus one and one.
sentences.zh: 它也满射到这个区间。任取 −1 < x < 1。

sentences.en: The point x, square root of one minus x squared, lies in U plus and maps to x.
sentences.zh: 点 (x, √(1 − x²)) 属于 U₊，并且被映到 x。

sentences.en: Fourth, the inverse is continuous, because the square root is continuous on the interval from zero to one.
sentences.zh: 第四，逆映射连续，因为 √ 在 (0, 1] 上连续。

sentences.en: Finally, the image, the open interval from minus one to one, is open in R. So phi plus is a chart.
sentences.zh: 最后，像 (−1, 1) 是 ℝ 中的开集。所以 φ₊ 是一个 chart。

sentences.en: Why insist that the domain and the image be open? Suppose we include the two endpoints.
sentences.zh: 为什么要求定义域和像是开集？假设把两个端点也算进来。

sentences.en: On the closed upper half circle, the same projection is still injective, but its image is the closed interval from minus one to one.
sentences.zh: 在闭上半圆上，同样的投影仍是单射，但像变成闭区间 [−1, 1]。

sentences.en: Zoom in at the point one, zero. On the circle, every small neighborhood of it contains points on both sides.
sentences.zh: 在点 (1, 0) 处放大：圆上它的每个小邻域两侧都有点。

sentences.en: At the endpoint one of the interval, a small neighborhood only reaches to the left.
sentences.zh: 而在区间端点 1 处，小邻域只伸向左侧。

sentences.en: The closed interval is not open, and the chart would wrongly report a boundary point on a circle that has no boundary.
sentences.zh: 闭区间不是开集；这样的 chart 会在一个没有边界的圆上误报出边界点。

sentences.en: Being injective is not enough either. The map must be a homeomorphism, continuous in both directions.
sentences.zh: 只是单射也不够：映射必须是同胚，两个方向都连续。

sentences.en: Recall the wrapped interval. Its inverse is a bijection, but it jumps at one, zero.
sentences.zh: 回想卷起来的区间：它的逆是双射，但在 (1, 0) 处跳变。

sentences.en: And its image, from zero to two pi with zero included, is not open either.
sentences.zh: 而且它的像 [0, 2π) 也不是开集。

sentences.en: Without continuity, neighboring points of the manifold could get coordinates far apart.
sentences.zh: 没有连续性，流形上相邻的点可能拿到相距很远的坐标，

sentences.en: Then convergence on the manifold would be invisible in coordinates.
sentences.zh: 那样流形上的收敛在坐标里就看不出来。

sentences.en: So why not one chart for the whole circle? Project the whole circle onto the x axis.
sentences.zh: 那为什么不用一个 chart 盖住整个圆？把整圆投影到 x 轴上。

sentences.en: Every x strictly between minus one and one is claimed by two points, one above and one below. The projection is not injective.
sentences.zh: 每个 −1 < x < 1 都被上下两个点争抢，投影不是单射。

sentences.en: In fact, no single chart can cover the circle, however clever. Let us prove it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论多巧妙，任何单个 chart 都盖不住圆。我们来证明。

sentences.en: We borrow two facts from analysis, and state them without proof.
sentences.zh: 我们借用两条分析学的事实，只陈述，不证明。

sentences.en: Fact one: a bounded closed subset of R d is compact, and the continuous image of a compact set is compact.
sentences.zh: 事实一：ℝᵈ 中有界闭集是紧集；紧集在连续映射下的像是紧集。

sentences.en: Fact two: R d is connected, so its only subsets that are both open and closed are the empty set and R d itself.
sentences.zh: 事实二：ℝᵈ 连通，既开又闭的子集只有 ∅ 和 ℝᵈ 本身。

sentences.en: Now suppose phi is a chart defined on the whole circle, a homeomorphism onto an open set V in R d.
sentences.zh: 现在假设 φ 是定义在整个圆上的 chart，是到 ℝᵈ 中开集 V 的同胚。

sentences.en: A third borrowed fact, invariance of dimension, forces d to be one, but the argument below works for any d.
sentences.zh: 第三条借用的事实——维数不变性——迫使 d = 1；不过下面的论证对任意 d 都成立。

sentences.en: The circle is bounded and closed in the plane, so it is compact, and therefore V, its continuous image, is compact.
sentences.zh: 圆在平面中有界且闭，所以是紧集；因此它的连续像 V 也是紧集。

sentences.en: A compact subset of R d is bounded and closed. So V is closed, V is open, and V is not empty.
sentences.zh: ℝᵈ 中的紧集有界且闭。所以 V 是闭集，又是开集，并且非空。

sentences.en: By connectedness, V must be all of R d. But V is bounded, and R d is not. That is a contradiction.
sentences.zh: 由连通性，V 只能是整个 ℝᵈ；但 V 有界而 ℝᵈ 无界，矛盾。

sentences.en: So every atlas of the circle needs at least two charts.
sentences.zh: 所以圆的任何图册都至少需要两个 chart。

sentences.en: Here is one that works: four half circles.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个可行的图册：四个半圆。

sentences.en: The upper half U plus and the lower half U minus both use the coordinate x.
sentences.zh: 上半圆 U₊ 和下半圆 U₋ 都用坐标 x。

sentences.en: The right half U r and the left half U l both use the coordinate y.
sentences.zh: 右半圆 U_r 和左半圆 U_l 都用坐标 y。

sentences.en: Together they cover the circle, because no point of the circle has x and y both equal to zero.
sentences.zh: 它们合起来覆盖整个圆，因为圆上没有点的 x 和 y 同时为 0。

sentences.en: Neighboring half circles overlap on open quarter arcs.
sentences.zh: 相邻的半圆在开的四分之一圆弧上重叠。

sentences.en: Another atlas uses stereographic projection from the north pole N, at zero, one.
sentences.zh: 另一个图册用球极投影：从北极 N = (0, 1) 出发投影。

sentences.en: Draw the line from N through a point p of the circle, and let u be where it meets the x axis.
sentences.zh: 从 N 过圆上一点 p 画直线，它与 x 轴的交点记为 u。

sentences.en: This gives sigma N of x, y equals x over one minus y, defined everywhere except at N.
sentences.zh: 这给出 σ_N(x, y) = x / (1 − y)，除 N 之外处处有定义。

sentences.en: As p approaches N, the line becomes horizontal, and u runs off to infinity.
sentences.zh: p 趋近 N 时，直线趋于水平，u 跑向无穷远。

sentences.en: To invert it, parametrize the line through N and the point u, zero as t times u, together with one minus t.
sentences.zh: 求逆：过 N 与点 (u, 0) 的直线参数化为 (tu, 1 − t)。

sentences.en: Substituting into the circle equation, t times the quantity t times u squared plus one, minus two, equals zero.
sentences.zh: 代入圆的方程：t(t(u² + 1) − 2) = 0。

sentences.en: The root t equals zero is N itself, so the other root is t equals two over u squared plus one.
sentences.zh: 根 t = 0 对应 N 本身，所以另一个根是 t = 2 / (u² + 1)。

sentences.en: Hence sigma N inverse of u is two u over u squared plus one, together with u squared minus one over u squared plus one.
Checking back, one minus y equals two over u squared plus one, so x over one minus y is exactly u.
sentences.zh: 反向验证：1 − y = 2 / (u² + 1)，所以 x / (1 − y) 恰好等于 u。

sentences.en: Projecting from the south pole instead gives sigma S equals x over one plus y, defined away from S, and the two projections together cover the circle.
sentences.zh: 改从南极投影得到 σ_S = x / (1 + y)，在 S 以外有定义；两个投影合起来覆盖整个圆。

sentences.en: Looking like R d near every point does not stop a space from misbehaving globally.
sentences.zh: 每一点附近都像 ℝᵈ，并不能阻止空间在整体上出现病态。

sentences.en: Charts alone are not enough to define a manifold.
sentences.zh: 仅有 chart 还不足以定义流形。

sentences.en: A topological space M is a d-dimensional topological manifold if it satisfies three conditions.
sentences.zh: 拓扑空间 M 称为 d 维拓扑流形，若满足三个条件。

sentences.en: First, it is locally Euclidean: every point lies in the domain of some d-dimensional chart.
sentences.zh: 一，局部欧氏：每个点都落在某个 d 维 chart 的定义域内。

sentences.en: Second, it is Hausdorff: any two distinct points p and q have disjoint open sets, U containing p and V containing q.
sentences.zh: 二，Hausdorff：任意两个不同点 p、q，存在不相交的开集 U ∋ p、V ∋ q；

sentences.en: Third, it is second countable: its topology has a countable basis.
sentences.zh: 三，第二可数：拓扑有一个可数的基。

sentences.en: The circle is a one-dimensional topological manifold. The four half-circle charts make it locally Euclidean.
sentences.zh: 圆是 1 维拓扑流形：四个半圆 chart 说明它局部欧氏。

sentences.en: It inherits the other two conditions from the plane, since every subspace of R two is Hausdorff and second countable.
sentences.zh: 另外两条继承自平面，因为 ℝ² 的子空间都是 Hausdorff 且第二可数的。

sentences.en: Why do we need Hausdorff? Here is a space that is locally Euclidean but not Hausdorff: the line with two origins.
sentences.zh: 为什么需要 Hausdorff？这里有一个局部欧氏但不 Hausdorff 的空间：双原点直线。

sentences.en: Take two copies of the real line, an upper copy and a lower copy.
sentences.zh: 取实直线的两份拷贝：上面一份，下面一份。

sentences.en: Glue them at every point t except zero: t on the upper copy and t on the lower copy become the same point.
sentences.zh: 除 0 以外的每个 t 都粘合：上面的 t 和下面的 t 成为同一个点。

sentences.en: The zeros are not glued. What remains is one line, but with two origins, zero a and zero b.
sentences.zh: 两个零点不粘合。结果是一条直线，但有两个原点 0_a 和 0_b。

sentences.en: A set is open exactly when its part in each copy is open in R.
sentences.zh: 一个集合是开集，当且仅当它在每一份拷贝中的部分都是 ℝ 中的开集。

sentences.en: So take any open set around zero a. It contains an interval from minus epsilon to epsilon, with its zero replaced by zero a.
sentences.zh: 所以任取 0_a 的开邻域，它包含一段 (−ε, ε)，只是其中的零点换成了 0_a。

sentences.en: Near every point, this space still looks like the real line.
sentences.zh: 在每个点附近，这个空间仍然像实直线。

sentences.en: The upper copy is open in this space, and reading off t is a homeomorphism from it onto R. That is a chart around zero a.
sentences.zh: 上面一份是这个空间中的开集，读出 t 给出它到 ℝ 的同胚：这是包含 0_a 的 chart。

sentences.en: The lower copy gives a chart around zero b, and every other point lies in both charts.
sentences.zh: 下面一份给出包含 0_b 的 chart；其余每个点同时落在两个 chart 中。

sentences.en: But the two origins cannot be separated.
sentences.zh: 但两个原点分不开。

sentences.en: Take open sets around zero a and around zero b. The first contains some interval from zero to epsilon, the second some interval from zero to delta.
sentences.zh: 取 0_a 与 0_b 的开邻域：前者包含某段 (0, ε)，后者包含某段 (0, δ)。

sentences.en: However small we make them, both contain the point half the smaller of epsilon and delta. They always overlap.
sentences.zh: 无论取多小，两者都包含点 min(ε, δ)/2，总是重叠。

sentences.en: So there are no disjoint neighborhoods, and the space is not Hausdorff.
sentences.zh: 所以不存在不相交的邻域，这个空间不是 Hausdorff 的。

sentences.en: Now watch the sequence x k equals one over k.
sentences.zh: 现在看数列 x_k = 1/k。

sentences.en: Take any open set around zero a. It contains some interval from zero to epsilon, and once k is larger than one over epsilon, x k lies inside.
sentences.zh: 任取 0_a 的开邻域，它包含某段 (0, ε)；当 k > 1/ε 时，x_k 落在其中。

sentences.en: So x k converges to zero a. By the same argument, x k also converges to zero b.
sentences.zh: 所以 x_k → 0_a。同样的论证说明 x_k → 0_b。

sentences.en: One sequence, two limits. For an optimization algorithm, the question of where the iterates converge would have no unique answer.
sentences.zh: 一个数列，两个极限。对优化算法而言，“迭代收敛到哪里”就没有唯一答案。

sentences.en: Worse, continuous functions cannot even tell the two limits apart.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，连续函数甚至无法区分这两个极限。

sentences.en: For any continuous f on this space, f of zero a equals the limit of f of one over k, which equals f of zero b.
sentences.zh: 对这个空间上任意连续函数 f，f(0_a) = lim f(1/k) = f(0_b)。

sentences.en: Both equalities hold because continuous maps send convergent sequences to convergent sequences, and limits in R are unique.
sentences.zh: 两个等号成立，是因为连续映射把收敛数列映成收敛数列，而 ℝ 中的极限唯一。

sentences.en: In a Hausdorff space this cannot happen. Claim: if x k converges to x and also to y, then x equals y.
sentences.zh: 在 Hausdorff 空间里这不会发生。命题：若 x_k → x 且 x_k → y，则 x = y。

sentences.en: Suppose x and y are different. By the Hausdorff property, there are disjoint open sets, U containing x and V containing y.
sentences.zh: 反设 x ≠ y。由 Hausdorff 性质，存在不相交的开集 U ∋ x、V ∋ y。

sentences.en: Since x k converges to x, there is an index K one such that x k lies in U for all k at least K one.
sentences.zh: 由 x_k → x，存在 K₁，使得 k ≥ K₁ 时 x_k ∈ U。

sentences.en: Since x k converges to y, there is an index K two such that x k lies in V for all k at least K two.
sentences.zh: 由 x_k → y，存在 K₂，使得 k ≥ K₂ 时 x_k ∈ V。

sentences.en: Take k equal to the larger of K one and K two. Then x k lies in both U and V, but their intersection is empty. Contradiction.
sentences.zh: 取 k = max(K₁, K₂)，则 x_k 同时属于 U 和 V，但 U ∩ V = ∅，矛盾。

sentences.en: So limits are unique, and the line with two origins fails exactly at the first step: the disjoint open sets do not exist.
sentences.zh: 所以极限唯一。双原点直线恰好在第一步失败：不相交的开集不存在。

sentences.en: The third condition, second countability, rules out spaces that are too large.
sentences.zh: 第三个条件，第二可数，排除了“过大”的空间。

sentences.en: For example, take uncountably many disjoint copies of the real line. It is locally Euclidean and Hausdorff, but it has no countable basis.
sentences.zh: 例如不可数多条实直线的不交并：它局部欧氏、Hausdorff，但没有可数的基。

sentences.en: This condition is technical, and this course does not develop it. It is used later, for example when a Riemannian metric is built on a manifold.
sentences.zh: 这是技术性条件，本课程不展开；后面会用到它，例如在流形上构造黎曼度量。

sentences.en: So a topological manifold is locally Euclidean, Hausdorff, and second countable.
sentences.zh: 所以拓扑流形是局部欧氏、Hausdorff、第二可数的空间。

sentences.en: Two maps of the same city give one building two different coordinates, and there is a formula to convert between them.
sentences.zh: 同一座城市的两张地图，给同一栋楼不同的坐标，两者之间有一个换算公式。

sentences.en: On a manifold, a point usually lies in several charts at once.
sentences.zh: 在流形上，一个点通常同时落在好几个 chart 里。

sentences.en: Take the upper half circle U plus, with coordinate x, and the right half circle U r, with coordinate y.
sentences.zh: 取上半圆 U₊，坐标为 x；以及右半圆 U_r，坐标为 y。

sentences.en: They overlap on the open quarter arc in the first quadrant, where x and y are both positive.
sentences.zh: 它们在第一象限的开四分之一圆弧上重叠，那里 x、y 都为正。

sentences.en: Pick a point p in the overlap, say p equals zero point six, zero point eight.
sentences.zh: 在重叠区取一点 p，比如 p = (0.6, 0.8)。

sentences.en: The first chart gives p the number zero point six. The second gives it zero point eight.
sentences.zh: 第一个 chart 给 p 的数是 0.6，第二个给的是 0.8。

sentences.en: Converting one coordinate into the other is called a transition map.
sentences.zh: 把一个坐标换算成另一个坐标，叫做转移映射。

sentences.en: In general, for charts U, phi and V, psi with overlapping domains, the transition map is psi composed with phi inverse,
sentences.zh: 一般地，对定义域相交的两个 chart (U, φ)、(V, ψ)，转移映射是 ψ∘φ⁻¹，

sentences.en: going from phi of U intersect V, to psi of U intersect V.
sentences.zh: 从 φ(U ∩ V) 映到 ψ(U ∩ V)。

sentences.en: A homeomorphism carries the open set U intersect V to an open set, so both of these are open subsets of R d.
sentences.zh: 同胚把开集 U ∩ V 映成开集，所以这两个集合都是 ℝᵈ 的开子集。

sentences.en: So a transition map is an ordinary map between open sets of R d, and ordinary calculus applies to it.
sentences.zh: 所以转移映射是 ℝᵈ 开集之间的普通映射，可以直接用普通的微积分。

sentences.en: Let us compute it for our two half circles.
sentences.zh: 来计算两个半圆之间的转移映射。

sentences.en: Points of U plus have x between minus one and one, and the overlap adds the condition that x is positive.
sentences.zh: U₊ 中的点满足 −1 < x < 1，重叠区再加上条件 x > 0。

sentences.en: So phi plus maps the overlap onto the interval from zero to one. By the same reasoning, so does phi r.
sentences.zh: 所以 φ₊ 把重叠区映满 (0, 1)；同理，φ_r 也是。

sentences.en: Now take x in that interval. Phi plus inverse lifts it to the point x, square root of one minus x squared.
sentences.zh: 取该区间中的 x，φ₊⁻¹ 把它抬到点 (x, √(1 − x²))。

sentences.en: Phi r reads off the y coordinate, so the transition map sends x to the square root of one minus x squared.
sentences.zh: φ_r 读出 y 坐标，所以转移映射把 x 送到 √(1 − x²)。

sentences.en: As p slides along the overlap, its pair of coordinates traces out this curve.
sentences.zh: p 沿重叠弧滑动时，它的两个坐标描出这条曲线。

sentences.en: Is it smooth? On the open interval, one minus x squared is positive, and the square root is infinitely differentiable on the positive reals.
sentences.zh: 它光滑吗？在开区间上 1 − x² > 0，而 √ 在 (0, ∞) 上无穷次可微。

sentences.en: So the composition is smooth, with derivative minus x over the square root of one minus x squared.
sentences.zh: 所以复合映射光滑，导数为 −x / √(1 − x²)。

sentences.en: The inverse transition map, from y back to x, is the square root of one minus y squared, smooth by the same argument.
sentences.zh: 反方向的转移映射，从 y 回到 x，是 √(1 − y²)，同理光滑。

sentences.en: Notice what happens near x equals one. The slope blows up, and the tangent line turns vertical.
sentences.zh: 注意 x 接近 1 时：斜率发散，切线变得竖直。

sentences.en: But x equals one is not in the domain. The overlap is open, so its endpoints are excluded.
sentences.zh: 但 x = 1 不在定义域中：重叠区是开集，端点不包含在内。

sentences.en: If we allowed the closure of the overlap, the transition map would fail to be differentiable at its endpoint. Openness protects smoothness.
sentences.zh: 如果允许重叠区的闭包，转移映射在端点处就不可微。开集这一要求保护了光滑性。

sentences.en: Now the stereographic charts.
sentences.zh: 再看球极投影的两个 chart。

sentences.en: A point p, away from both poles, projects from N to u, and from S to v.
sentences.zh: 不在两极的点 p，从 N 投影得到 u，从 S 投影得到 v。

sentences.en: The two charts overlap on the circle without N and S, and sigma N maps that overlap onto the real line without zero.
sentences.zh: 两个 chart 的重叠区是 S¹ 去掉 N、S；σ_N 把它映满 ℝ∖{0}。

sentences.en: Earlier we found that sigma N inverse of u is two u over u squared plus one, together with u squared minus one over u squared plus one.
sentences.zh: 前面已求得 σ_N⁻¹(u) = (2u / (u² + 1), (u² − 1) / (u² + 1))。

sentences.en: For nonzero u this point is not S, so we may apply sigma S, which divides x by one plus y.
sentences.zh: u ≠ 0 时这个点不是 S，所以可以作用 σ_S：用 x 除以 1 + y。

sentences.en: Here one plus y equals two u squared over u squared plus one.
sentences.zh: 这里 1 + y = 2u² / (u² + 1)。

sentences.en: Dividing, the factors u squared plus one cancel, and two u over two u squared leaves one over u.
sentences.zh: 相除后 u² + 1 约去，2u / 2u² 剩下 1/u。

sentences.en: So the transition map is u maps to one over u, smooth on the real line without zero, and it is its own inverse.
sentences.zh: 所以转移映射是 u ↦ 1/u，在 ℝ∖{0} 上光滑，并且是它自身的逆。

sentences.en: Transition maps are ordinary functions between open sets of R d. Next we ask what goes wrong when they are not smooth.
sentences.zh: 转移映射是 ℝᵈ 开集之间的普通函数。下一章问：如果它们不光滑，会出什么问题？

scenes.title: Why Charts Must Be Smoothly Compatible

sentences.en: We would like to say that a function on a manifold is smooth when it looks smooth in coordinates.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这样定义：流形上的函数光滑，就是它在坐标里看起来光滑。

sentences.en: But there are many coordinate systems. If converting between two of them is not smooth, they can disagree.
sentences.zh: 但坐标系不止一套。如果两套坐标之间的换算不光滑，它们就可能给出不同的结论。

sentences.en: Here is the simplest example. The manifold is the real line, with its usual topology.
sentences.zh: 最简单的例子：流形就是实直线，取通常的拓扑。

sentences.en: The first chart is the identity: the point p gets the coordinate x equals p.
sentences.zh: 第一个 chart 是恒等映射：点 p 的坐标是 x = p。

sentences.en: The second chart, kappa, gives p the coordinate u equals p cubed.
sentences.zh: 第二个 chart κ 给 p 的坐标是 u = p³。

sentences.en: Evenly spaced points keep their spacing in the first chart, but in the second they bunch up near zero and spread out far away.
sentences.zh: 等距的点在第一个 chart 里保持等距；在第二个里，它们在 0 附近挤在一起，远处则拉开。

sentences.en: Both charts are homeomorphisms.
sentences.zh: 两个 chart 都是同胚。

sentences.en: The identity clearly is. And p cubed is strictly increasing and onto, so it is a continuous bijection.
sentences.zh: 恒等映射显然是。p³ 严格递增且满射，所以是连续双射；

sentences.en: Its inverse, the real cube root, is continuous too.
sentences.zh: 它的逆，实立方根，也连续。

sentences.en: Now take the function f of p equals p.
sentences.zh: 现在取函数 f(p) = p。

sentences.en: In the first chart, its coordinate expression, f after identity inverse, is x itself: a straight line, perfectly smooth.
sentences.zh: 在第一个 chart 中，坐标表示 f∘id⁻¹(x) = x：一条直线，完全光滑。

sentences.en: In the second chart, the coordinate expression, f after kappa inverse, is the cube root of u.
sentences.zh: 在第二个 chart 中，坐标表示 f∘κ⁻¹(u) 是 u 的立方根。

sentences.en: At u equals zero, this curve stands vertical.
sentences.zh: 在 u = 0 处，这条曲线竖直。

sentences.en: The difference quotient, the cube root of h divided by h, equals h to the minus two thirds, and it grows without bound as h goes to zero.
At h equals zero point one, it is about four point six. At zero point zero one, about twenty one point five. At zero point zero zero one, one hundred.
So in the second chart, f is not even differentiable at zero.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二个 chart 中，f 在 0 处甚至不可微。

sentences.en: The same function is smooth in one chart and not smooth in the other. Which answer is right?
sentences.zh: 同一个函数，在一个 chart 中光滑，在另一个中不光滑。哪个答案对？

sentences.en: The trouble lies in the conversion between the two charts.
sentences.zh: 毛病出在两个 chart 之间的换算上。

sentences.en: Kappa after identity inverse sends x to x cubed, which is smooth.
sentences.zh: κ∘id⁻¹ 把 x 送到 x³，是光滑的。

sentences.en: But identity after kappa inverse sends u to the cube root of u, which is not.
sentences.zh: 但 id∘κ⁻¹ 把 u 送到 u 的立方根，不光滑。

sentences.en: Two charts are called smoothly compatible if their domains do not meet, or if both transition maps are infinitely differentiable.
sentences.zh: 两个 chart 称为光滑相容，若它们的定义域不相交，或者两个方向的转移映射都是 C∞。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the transition map is a diffeomorphism between open subsets of R d.
sentences.zh: 等价地说，转移映射是 ℝᵈ 开子集之间的微分同胚。

sentences.en: The identity and kappa fail this test, and that failure is exactly what made the verdict on f ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 恒等映射与 κ 通不过这个检验，正是这一点让 f 的判定产生歧义。

sentences.en: A smooth atlas is a collection of charts whose domains cover M, any two of which are smoothly compatible.
sentences.zh: 光滑图册是一族 chart：定义域覆盖 M，且两两光滑相容。

sentences.en: The four half circles form a smooth atlas on the circle. So do the two stereographic projections.
sentences.zh: 四个半圆构成圆上的光滑图册，两个球极投影也是。

sentences.en: Moreover, every half-circle chart is compatible with every stereographic chart, so together they still form one smooth atlas.
sentences.zh: 而且每个半圆 chart 都与每个球极投影 chart 相容，所以合起来仍是一个光滑图册。

sentences.en: But they are different sets of charts.
sentences.zh: 但它们是不同的 chart 集合。

sentences.en: If a smooth manifold were a space plus one particular atlas, the same circle would count as two different manifolds.
sentences.zh: 若光滑流形定义为“空间 + 某个具体图册”，同一个圆就成了两个不同的流形。

sentences.en: The fix is the maximal atlas: a smooth atlas that cannot be enlarged by any chart compatible with all of its charts.
sentences.zh: 解决办法是极大图册：一个光滑图册，不能再加入任何与其全部 chart 相容的新 chart。

sentences.en: A maximal atlas is also called a smooth structure, and a smooth manifold is a topological manifold together with a smooth structure.
sentences.zh: 极大图册也叫光滑结构；光滑流形就是拓扑流形加上一个光滑结构。

sentences.en: Claim: every smooth atlas lies in exactly one maximal atlas.
sentences.zh: 命题：每个光滑图册都包含在唯一的极大图册中。

sentences.en: Call the given atlas script A. Let A-bar be the set of all charts compatible with every chart of script A.
sentences.zh: 设给定图册为 A。令 Ā 为与 A 中每个 chart 都相容的全部 chart。

sentences.en: Clearly, A-bar contains script A.
sentences.zh: 显然 A ⊆ Ā。

sentences.en: Step two: any two charts of A-bar are compatible with each other. Take U one, phi one and U two, phi two in A-bar.
sentences.zh: 第二步：Ā 中任意两个 chart 互相相容。取 (U₁, φ₁)、(U₂, φ₂) ∈ Ā。

sentences.en: Pick x in phi one of U one intersect U two, and let p be phi one inverse of x.
sentences.zh: 取 x ∈ φ₁(U₁ ∩ U₂)，令 p = φ₁⁻¹(x)。

sentences.en: Choose a chart W, theta of the original atlas that contains p.
sentences.zh: 在原图册中取一个包含 p 的 chart (W, θ)。

sentences.en: On the open set phi one of U one intersect U two intersect W, which contains x, the transition map can pass through the theta coordinates.
sentences.zh: 在包含 x 的开集 φ₁(U₁ ∩ U₂ ∩ W) 上，转移映射可以经过 θ 坐标中转。

sentences.en: Phi two after phi one inverse equals phi two after theta inverse, composed with theta after phi one inverse.
sentences.zh: φ₂∘φ₁⁻¹ = (φ₂∘θ⁻¹)∘(θ∘φ₁⁻¹)。

sentences.en: Both factors are smooth, because both charts of A-bar are compatible with theta. So the composition is smooth near x.
sentences.zh: 两个因子都光滑，因为 Ā 中的两个 chart 都与 θ 相容。所以复合在 x 附近光滑。

sentences.en: Smoothness is a local property and x was arbitrary, so the transition map is smooth on its whole domain. The reverse direction is the same.
sentences.zh: 光滑是局部性质，x 任意，所以转移映射在整个定义域上光滑；反方向同理。

sentences.en: Step three, maximality: a chart compatible with everything in A-bar is in particular compatible with script A, so it already lies in A-bar.
sentences.zh: 第三步，极大性：与 Ā 中所有 chart 相容的 chart，特别地与 A 相容，所以已经在 Ā 中。

sentences.en: Step four, uniqueness: any maximal atlas B containing script A consists of charts compatible with script A, so B lies inside A-bar.
sentences.zh: 第四步，唯一性：任何包含 A 的极大图册 B 由与 A 相容的 chart 组成，所以 B ⊆ Ā。

sentences.en: A-bar is a smooth atlas containing B, so by the maximality of B, the two are equal.
sentences.zh: Ā 是包含 B 的光滑图册，由 B 的极大性，两者相等。

sentences.en: So the half circles and the stereographic charts determine the same smooth structure on the circle.
sentences.zh: 所以半圆图册与球极投影图册决定圆上同一个光滑结构。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the single chart kappa is a smooth atlas on the real line by itself.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，单个 chart κ 自己就是 ℝ 上的一个光滑图册。

sentences.en: It determines a different smooth structure from the identity, since the two are not compatible.
sentences.zh: 它与恒等映射不相容，所以决定一个不同的光滑结构。

sentences.en: A smooth structure is extra data, chosen on top of the topology.
sentences.zh: 光滑结构是在拓扑之上额外选择的数据。

scenes.title: Smooth Maps Do Not Depend on the Charts

sentences.en: With a smooth structure in hand, we can define smooth maps between manifolds.
sentences.zh: 有了光滑结构，就可以定义流形之间的光滑映射。

sentences.en: The idea: move the map into coordinates, and judge smoothness there.
sentences.zh: 思路：把映射搬进坐标里，在坐标里判断光滑性。

sentences.en: Let M and N be smooth manifolds of dimensions m and n, and let F from M to N be continuous.
sentences.zh: 设 M、N 分别是 m 维、n 维光滑流形，F : M → N 连续。

sentences.en: F is smooth if for every point p there are charts U, phi around p and V, psi around F of p, with F of U inside V,
sentences.zh: 称 F 光滑，若对每个 p，有 chart (U, φ) ∋ p、(V, ψ) ∋ F(p)，且 F(U) ⊆ V，

sentences.en: such that the coordinate representation, F hat equals psi after F after phi inverse, is infinitely differentiable from phi of U to psi of V.
sentences.zh: 并且坐标表示 F̂ = ψ∘F∘φ⁻¹ : φ(U) → ψ(V) 是 C∞ 的。

sentences.en: Why assume F continuous? Given a chart V around F of p, we can shrink U to U intersect F inverse of V.
sentences.zh: 为什么要求 F 连续？给定 F(p) 附近的 chart V，可以把 U 缩小为 U ∩ F⁻¹(V)。

sentences.en: Continuity makes this set open, so the condition F of U inside V can always be arranged.
sentences.zh: 连续性保证它仍是开集，所以条件 F(U) ⊆ V 总能满足。

sentences.en: But the definition picks one pair of charts. What if we choose another pair?
sentences.zh: 但定义只挑了一对 chart。换一对 chart 呢？

sentences.en: We must prove that the answer does not depend on that choice.
sentences.zh: 我们必须证明，结论与这个选择无关。

sentences.en: Suppose F is smooth near p with respect to U, phi and V, psi.
sentences.zh: 设 F 在 p 附近关于 (U, φ)、(V, ψ) 光滑。

sentences.en: Take any other charts U prime, phi prime around p, and V prime, psi prime around F of p.
sentences.zh: 另取任意 chart (U′, φ′) ∋ p 和 (V′, ψ′) ∋ F(p)。

sentences.en: Step one, a common domain. Let W be U intersect U prime, intersect F inverse of V intersect V prime.
sentences.zh: 第一步，公共定义域。令 W = U ∩ U′ ∩ F⁻¹(V ∩ V′)。

sentences.en: U intersect U prime is open. F is continuous and V intersect V prime is open, so its preimage is open. Hence W is an open set containing p.
sentences.zh: U ∩ U′ 是开集；F 连续而 V ∩ V′ 是开集，所以其原像是开集。因此 W 是包含 p 的开集。

sentences.en: So phi prime of W is an open subset of R m containing phi prime of p.
sentences.zh: 于是 φ′(W) 是 ℝᵐ 中包含 φ′(p) 的开集。

sentences.en: Step two, split the new representation.
sentences.zh: 第二步，拆分新的坐标表示。

sentences.en: For x in phi prime of W, the point phi prime inverse of x lies in U, so we may insert phi inverse after phi, which is the identity on U.
sentences.zh: 对 x ∈ φ′(W)，点 φ′⁻¹(x) 属于 U，所以可以插入 φ⁻¹∘φ，它是 U 上的恒等映射。

sentences.en: Its image under F lies in V, so we may also insert psi inverse after psi, the identity on V.
sentences.zh: 它在 F 下的像属于 V，所以还可以插入 ψ⁻¹∘ψ，即 V 上的恒等映射。

sentences.en: This gives: psi prime after F after phi prime inverse equals psi prime after psi inverse, then F hat, then phi after phi prime inverse.
Step three, each piece is smooth.
sentences.zh: 第三步，每一段都光滑。

sentences.en: Phi after phi prime inverse is a transition map between charts of the maximal atlas of M, so it is smooth by compatibility.
sentences.zh: φ∘φ′⁻¹ 是 M 的极大图册中两个 chart 之间的转移映射，由相容性是光滑的。

sentences.en: The middle piece, psi after F after phi inverse, is smooth by assumption.
sentences.zh: 中间一段 ψ∘F∘φ⁻¹ 按假设光滑。

sentences.en: Psi prime after psi inverse is a transition map between charts of N, smooth again by compatibility.
sentences.zh: ψ′∘ψ⁻¹ 是 N 的两个 chart 之间的转移映射，同样由相容性光滑。

sentences.en: Step four: a composition of smooth maps between open subsets of Euclidean space is smooth, by the chain rule applied at every order.
sentences.zh: 第四步：欧氏空间开集之间光滑映射的复合仍光滑，这由逐阶使用链式法则得到。

sentences.en: So the new coordinate representation is smooth near phi prime of p. Smoothness does not depend on the charts.
sentences.zh: 所以新的坐标表示在 φ′(p) 附近光滑。光滑性与 chart 的选择无关。

sentences.en: The same argument shows that a composition of smooth maps is smooth.
sentences.zh: 同样的论证说明光滑映射的复合仍光滑：

sentences.en: The representation of G after F is the representation of G, composed with the representation of F.
sentences.zh: G∘F 的坐标表示就是 G 的坐标表示与 F 的坐标表示的复合。

sentences.en: Now see where the proof needs each hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 现在看证明在哪里用到了每个条件。

sentences.en: If the charts were not compatible, a transition piece could fail to be smooth, and the chain would break right there.
sentences.zh: 如果 chart 不相容，某段转移映射可能不光滑，链条就在那里断开。

sentences.en: Back on the real line, switch the chart from the identity to kappa.
sentences.zh: 回到实直线：把 chart 从恒等映射换成 κ。

sentences.en: Then the transition piece, identity after kappa inverse, is the cube root. That is the broken link.
sentences.zh: 这时转移段 id∘κ⁻¹ 就是立方根，正是断开的那一环。

sentences.en: Then the same function f of p equals p flips from smooth to not smooth.
sentences.zh: 于是同一个 f(p) = p 的判定从“光滑”翻转为“不光滑”。

sentences.en: And if F were not continuous, the preimage of V intersect V prime might not be open.
sentences.zh: 若 F 不连续，V ∩ V′ 的原像可能不是开集。

sentences.en: Then W would not be open, and smoothness near phi prime of p would make no sense.
sentences.zh: 那样 W 就不是开集，“在 φ′(p) 附近光滑”无从谈起。

sentences.en: Finally, an example: the height function on the circle, F of x, y equals y, with values in R and the identity chart.
sentences.zh: 最后看一个例子：圆上的高度函数 F(x, y) = y，取值于 ℝ，ℝ 用恒等 chart。

sentences.en: In the chart phi plus, F hat of x is the square root of one minus x squared, for x between minus one and one. That is smooth.
sentences.zh: 在 chart φ₊ 下，F̂(x) = √(1 − x²)，−1 < x < 1，光滑。

sentences.en: In the chart phi r, the point with coordinate y has height y, so F hat of y is just y. That is also smooth.
sentences.zh: 在 chart φ_r 下，坐标为 y 的点高度就是 y，所以 F̂(y) = y，也光滑。

sentences.en: On the overlap, the two charts give the same verdict, as the theorem promised.
sentences.zh: 在重叠区上，两个 chart 给出相同的结论，正如定理所保证的。

sentences.en: In Riemannian optimization, the objective f from M to R is exactly such a smooth map, and this is what smooth means for it.
sentences.zh: 在黎曼优化中，目标函数 f : M → ℝ 正是这样的光滑映射，“f 光滑”指的就是这个意思。

sentences.en: A homeomorphism is sameness in the topological sense. What is sameness in the smooth sense?
sentences.zh: 同胚是拓扑意义下的“相同”。光滑意义下的“相同”是什么？

sentences.en: A homeomorphism may crumple a space, as long as nothing is torn or glued.
sentences.zh: 同胚可以把空间揉皱，只要不撕裂、不粘连。

sentences.en: A diffeomorphism must also be smooth in both directions, with no creases or cusps.
sentences.zh: 微分同胚还要求两个方向都光滑，不能有折痕或尖点。

sentences.en: Definition: F from M to N is a diffeomorphism if F is a bijection, F is smooth, and F inverse is smooth.
sentences.zh: 定义：F : M → N 是微分同胚，若 F 是双射、F 光滑、并且 F⁻¹ 光滑。

sentences.en: Consider F of x equals x cubed, on the real line with its standard smooth structure.
sentences.zh: 考虑 F(x) = x³，实直线取标准光滑结构。

sentences.en: F is a polynomial, so it is smooth.
sentences.zh: F 是多项式，所以光滑。

sentences.en: It is strictly increasing: if x one is less than x two, then x one cubed is less than x two cubed. So it is injective.
sentences.zh: 它严格递增：若 x₁ < x₂，则 x₁³ < x₂³。所以是单射。

sentences.en: It is onto: F is continuous and runs from minus infinity to plus infinity, so by the intermediate value theorem it takes every value.
sentences.zh: 它是满射：F 连续，从 −∞ 增到 +∞，由介值定理取遍所有值。

sentences.en: Evenly spaced inputs land bunched together near zero.
sentences.zh: 等距的输入，在 0 附近被挤到一起。

sentences.en: Its inverse is the cube root, obtained by reflecting the graph across the line y equals x.
sentences.zh: 它的逆是立方根，把图像关于直线 y = x 翻折得到。

sentences.en: The cube root is continuous, so F is a homeomorphism.
sentences.zh: 立方根连续，所以 F 是同胚。

sentences.en: But look at the inverse at zero.
sentences.zh: 但看逆映射在 0 处的情形。

sentences.en: The difference quotient, F inverse of h minus F inverse of zero, over h, equals h to the minus two thirds.
At h equals zero point one, it is four point six. At zero point zero one, twenty one point five. At zero point zero zero one, one hundred.
So F inverse is not differentiable at zero, and F is a smooth bijection that is not a diffeomorphism.
sentences.zh: 所以 F⁻¹ 在 0 处不可微；F 是光滑双射，却不是微分同胚。

sentences.en: The root cause is the derivative of F at zero, which is zero.
sentences.zh: 根源在于 F 在 0 处的导数为零。

sentences.en: A small segment of length two epsilon around zero is squashed to length two epsilon cubed. One direction is flattened.
sentences.zh: 0 附近长度为 2ε 的小线段被压成长度 2ε³，一个方向被压扁了。

sentences.en: Any inverse would have to stretch it back infinitely fast.
sentences.zh: 任何逆映射都必须以无限快的速率把它拉回去。

sentences.en: In general, suppose F is a diffeomorphism, and differentiate the identity F inverse after F equals the identity map.
sentences.zh: 一般地，设 F 是微分同胚，对恒等式 F⁻¹∘F = id 求导。

sentences.en: The chain rule gives: the derivative of F inverse at F of x, times F prime of x, equals one.
sentences.zh: 由链式法则：(F⁻¹)′(F(x)) · F′(x) = 1。

sentences.en: So F prime of x can never be zero. For x cubed, this necessary condition fails at zero.
sentences.zh: 所以 F′(x) 永远不能为零。对 x³，这个必要条件在 0 处不满足。

sentences.en: The inverse function theorem in the next episode shows that a nonzero derivative is also sufficient, locally.
sentences.zh: 下一集的反函数定理将说明：导数非零在局部上也是充分的。

sentences.en: Now a positive example, which answers a question from the compatibility chapter.
sentences.zh: 再看一个正面的例子，它回答了相容性一章留下的问题。

sentences.en: Give the domain the smooth structure of the chart kappa, give the target the structure of the identity, and consider the same map, p cubed.
sentences.zh: 定义域取 chart κ 的光滑结构，目标取恒等 chart 的结构，考虑同一个映射 p³。

sentences.en: Its coordinate representation is identity after kappa after kappa inverse, which sends u to u.
sentences.zh: 它的坐标表示是 id∘κ∘κ⁻¹，把 u 送到 u。

sentences.en: Its inverse has the representation kappa after kappa inverse after identity inverse, which sends x to x.
sentences.zh: 它的逆的坐标表示是 κ∘κ⁻¹∘id⁻¹，把 x 送到 x。

sentences.en: Both are smooth, so this map is a diffeomorphism. The two smooth structures are different, but as smooth manifolds they are essentially the same.
sentences.zh: 两者都光滑，所以这是微分同胚。两个光滑结构不同，但作为光滑流形本质相同。

sentences.en: Diffeomorphisms are exactly the changes of variables that preserve smoothness.
sentences.zh: 微分同胚恰好是保持光滑性的变量替换。

sentences.en: If F from M to N is a diffeomorphism and f on N is smooth, then f after F is smooth, as a composition of smooth maps.
sentences.zh: 若 F : M → N 是微分同胚，f 在 N 上光滑，则 f∘F 光滑，因为它是光滑映射的复合。

sentences.en: Conversely, if f after F is smooth, then f equals f after F, after F inverse, which is smooth too.
sentences.zh: 反之，若 f∘F 光滑，则 f = (f∘F)∘F⁻¹ 也光滑。

sentences.en: So changing the variables of an optimization problem by a diffeomorphism keeps smoothness intact.
sentences.zh: 所以用微分同胚对优化问题重新参数化，光滑性完整保留。

sentences.en: Let us fill in the dictionary between the topological world and the smooth world.
sentences.zh: 来填写拓扑世界与光滑世界之间的对照表。

sentences.en: Homeomorphisms correspond to diffeomorphisms.
sentences.zh: 同胚对应微分同胚。

sentences.en: Continuous maps correspond to smooth maps.
sentences.zh: 连续映射对应光滑映射。

sentences.en: And charts onto open subsets of R d correspond to compatible charts, which together form a smooth atlas.
sentences.zh: 到 ℝᵈ 开子集的 chart，对应彼此相容、组成光滑图册的 chart。

sentences.en: There are two ways to look at a manifold.
sentences.zh: 看流形有两种方式。

sentences.en: The intrinsic view is like being handed a stack of maps and conversion tables, with no mention of any space outside.
sentences.zh: 内蕴视角就像只拿到一叠地图和换算表，完全不提外部空间。

sentences.en: The manifold is a topological space with a maximal smooth atlas, and nothing more.
sentences.zh: 流形就是一个拓扑空间加上一个极大光滑图册，仅此而已。

sentences.en: The extrinsic view is like being told that the Earth is the set of points in space at distance one from the center.
sentences.zh: 外蕴视角就像被告知：地球是空间中到球心距离为 1 的点的集合。

sentences.en: The manifold is a subset of R n, cut out by an equation, h of x equals c.
sentences.zh: 流形是 ℝⁿ 的子集，由方程 h(x) = c 切出来。

sentences.en: Look again at the half-circle chart. It is really just solving an equation.
sentences.zh: 再看半圆 chart：它其实就是在解方程。

sentences.en: From x squared plus y squared equals one, on the upper arc we solve for y, and get y equals the square root of one minus x squared.
sentences.zh: 从 x² + y² = 1 出发，在上半弧上解出 y，得到 y = √(1 − x²)。

sentences.en: This works only where the partial derivative with respect to y, which is two y, is nonzero.
sentences.zh: 这只在对 y 的偏导数 2y 不为零的地方可行。

sentences.en: As the point approaches one, zero, two y goes to zero, and the tangent line turns vertical.
sentences.zh: 点趋近 (1, 0) 时，2y → 0，切线变得竖直。

sentences.en: There we cannot solve for y. Instead we solve for x, and get x equals the square root of one minus y squared on the right arc.
sentences.zh: 在那里无法解出 y；改为解出 x，在右半弧上得到 x = √(1 − y²)。

sentences.en: The sphere works the same way. S two is the set of points in R three with squared norm one.
sentences.zh: 球面也一样。S² 是 ℝ³ 中满足 ‖x‖² = 1 的点的集合。

sentences.en: Each of six open hemispheres can be described by solving for one coordinate.
sentences.zh: 六个开半球，每一个都可以通过解出一个坐标来描述。

sentences.en: For example, on the upper hemisphere, z equals the square root of one minus x squared minus y squared, and the chart sends x, y, z to x, y.
sentences.zh: 例如在上半球，z = √(1 − x² − y²)，chart 把 (x, y, z) 送到 (x, y)。

sentences.en: The six hemispheres, positive and negative in x, y and z, cover the whole sphere.
sentences.zh: x、y、z 正负两侧共六个半球，覆盖整个球面。

sentences.en: Now a space we really care about in optimization: the orthogonal group O n.
sentences.zh: 现在看优化中真正关心的空间：正交群 O(n)。

sentences.en: It is the set of n by n real matrices R with R transpose R equal to the identity.
sentences.zh: 它是满足 RᵀR = I 的 n×n 实矩阵 R 的集合。

sentences.en: That is n squared variables. How many equations?
sentences.zh: 变量有 n² 个。方程有几个？

sentences.en: The i, j entry of R transpose R is the inner product of column i with column j.
sentences.zh: RᵀR 的 (i, j) 元是第 i 列与第 j 列的内积。

sentences.en: That is symmetric in i and j, so the i, j equation and the j, i equation are the same equation.
sentences.zh: 它关于 i、j 对称，所以 (i, j) 与 (j, i) 是同一个方程。

sentences.en: The independent ones sit on and above the diagonal: n on the diagonal, and n times n minus one, over two, above it.
sentences.zh: 独立的方程位于对角线及其上方：对角线 n 个，上方 n(n − 1)/2 个。

sentences.en: In total, n times n plus one, over two equations.
sentences.zh: 合计 n(n + 1)/2 个方程。

sentences.en: So the expected dimension is n squared minus n times n plus one, over two, which simplifies to n times n minus one, over two.
sentences.zh: 所以预期维数是 n² − n(n + 1)/2，化简为 n(n − 1)/2。

sentences.en: For n equals two that is one, the single angle of a plane rotation. For n equals three: nine variables, six equations, expected dimension three.
sentences.zh: n = 2 时为 1，即平面旋转的一个角度；n = 3 时：9 个变量，6 个方程，预期维数 3。

sentences.en: But this is only an expectation. When the count gives the true dimension, and how to build charts, is the job of a later theorem. Here we only count.
sentences.zh: 但这只是预期。计数何时给出真实维数、如何构造 chart，是后面定理的任务。这里只计数。

sentences.en: So can we build charts for O three by hand, the way we did for the circle?
sentences.zh: 那么，能像对圆那样，手工构造 O(3) 的 chart 吗？

sentences.en: Which six of the nine entries should we solve for? What are the explicit formulas?
sentences.zh: 九个元素中该解出哪六个？显式表达式是什么？

sentences.en: And how do we cover all of O three with charts whose transition maps are smooth? By hand, this does not work.
sentences.zh: 又如何用转移映射光滑的 chart 覆盖整个 O(3)？手工做不下去。

sentences.en: What about a familiar parametrization, such as Euler angles? Here is a supplementary illustration.
sentences.zh: 熟悉的参数化，比如欧拉角，行不行？下面是一个补充示例。

sentences.en: In Z X Z Euler angles, a frame turns about z, then about the new x axis, then about the new z axis.
sentences.zh: 在 ZXZ 欧拉角中，坐标架先绕 z 轴转，再绕新的 x 轴转，最后绕新的 z 轴转。

sentences.en: When the middle angle goes to zero, the first and the third rotation axes coincide.
sentences.zh: 当中间角趋于 0 时，第一和第三个旋转轴重合。

sentences.en: Then the two outer angles act only through their sum: three parameters control only two degrees of freedom.
sentences.zh: 此时两个外角只通过它们的和起作用：三个参数只控制两个自由度。

sentences.en: Near those orientations the map is not a local homeomorphism, so a single convenient parametrization cannot serve as a chart.
sentences.zh: 在这些姿态附近，映射不是局部同胚，所以一个方便的参数化不能充当 chart。

sentences.en: What we need is a machine that turns equations into charts.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一台把方程变成 chart 的机器。

sentences.en: Feed it an equation, h of x equals c, together with a condition on the rank of the derivative.
sentences.zh: 输入方程 h(x) = c，以及关于导数秩的条件，

sentences.en: It returns charts, with smooth transition maps guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 它就输出 chart，并保证转移映射光滑。

sentences.en: The circle already hinted at the condition: we could solve for y exactly where the partial derivative two y was nonzero.
sentences.zh: 圆已经暗示了这个条件：恰好在偏导数 2y 非零的地方能解出 y。

sentences.en: That machine is built in the next two episodes: the inverse function theorem in episode three, and regular level sets in episode four.
sentences.zh: 这台机器在接下来两集中搭建：第三集的反函数定理，第四集的正则水平集。
